content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow (SRF): Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: a. Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests CSIR-UGC NET Including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. b. The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MOE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISC, IISER, NISER etc. With two years of research experience.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 32 years. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MOE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISC, IISER, NISER etc.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Kharagpur Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kharagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position is 03 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the SRF post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through national eligibility tests like CSIR-UGC NET or GATE, or national-level examinations conducted by government agencies.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Yes, the maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is 32 years. However, age relaxation may be applicable based on sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the SRF role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated compensation of up to Rs. 42,000 per month for the Senior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the SRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position in this recruitment drive by IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the IIT Kharagpur SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position is strictly online. Candidates need to fill out the application form on the official portal.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the SRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves candidates being selected through national-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIT Kharagpur offer any age relaxation for SRF candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, age rules may be relaxed for candidates upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any, indicating potential flexibility for deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a project-based position, meaning the role is tied to a specific research project and its duration.
